params.body:
The pipeline sends plain ids since gentells-pipeline#234 (or an object with `_id`, for a topic or region with its name). This reads them through one helper, `idOf` in `src/ids.js`, instead of `x._id || x._ref || x` in thirteen places.

It also fixes a bug: the pattern list on an insight's page (`InsightDetail.jsx`) read `p._id || p._ref`, without the plain fallback. `insights-rows` already sent plain ids, so every row there had no name and no key. A new Playwright test, "an insight's page names its patterns", fails on main and passes here.

- The mock for `insights-rows` sends patterns as plain ids, like the pipeline; `insight-detail` is mocked.
- Lint at the ceiling (24), build ok, Playwright 24 of 24.

Merge together with gentells-pipeline#234.
params.title: Read ids through one helper; an insight's page names its patterns
